name: Affiliate {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Learn distribution by selling someone else's real product.

commands.name: /affiliate
commands.does: Opens the partner portfolio with terms, stop conditions and trust cost.
commands.returns: One line per live partner, unresolved disclosure and missing stop conditions first.

commands.name: /partner-vet
commands.does: Vets a candidate product on evidence of use, before the commission rate is read.
commands.returns: A vetting record with the harm case, the coherence check and an accept or reject verdict.

commands.name: /partner-terms
commands.does: Records commission, attribution window, payout schedule, claim restrictions and the exit clause.
commands.returns: A terms record marking every term the partner can change unilaterally.

commands.name: /trust-cost
commands.does: Scores what a recommendation would cost in audience trust, independently of projected income.
commands.returns: Who is harmed, how visibly, and what recovering that trust would take.

commands.name: /disclosure
commands.does: Drafts the disclosure text and states where it must be published for this audience.
commands.returns: Disclosure text, required placement per surface, and an unresolved flag when the rules are ambiguous.

commands.name: /promotion
commands.does: Builds the promotion plan and writes its stop condition before launch.
commands.returns: A plan pending human approval, with the stop condition stated as a threshold.

commands.name: /promo-copy
commands.does: Drafts promotional copy in which every claim traces to recorded use evidence.
commands.returns: Unapproved draft copy plus the claims dropped for lack of evidence.

commands.name: /attribution
commands.does: Reconciles own tracking against the partner report for a payout period.
commands.returns: Both numbers, the gap, and the gap as a named finding with an amount.

commands.name: /affiliate-revenue
commands.does: Emits a reconciled period as an affiliate revenue event to Revenue {OS}.
commands.returns: The revenue event, or a refusal when the period is not reconciled.

commands.name: /partner-exit
commands.does: Withdraws from a partnership and drafts the notice to the audience.
commands.returns: A withdrawal record, the assets to take down, and an unapproved audience notice.

commands.name: /affiliate-review
commands.does: Reviews the portfolio against trust cost and return.
commands.returns: Keep, pause or exit per partner, each with its evidence.

requires_human_approval_for: signing or accepting any partner agreement or programme terms
promoting anything to an owned audience, on any surface
publishing any promotional copy, in the exact wording that will ship
publishing a promotion whose disclosure text is not already live
making any performance or outcome claim about a partner product
ending a promotion in a way the audience will notice
